# reversed

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transactionStatusReversed`](gmeow-transactionStatusReversed.md)

- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A transaction that has been reversed or voided. The original transaction record is retained with displayable false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)); the reversal is a separate event.
